scope: Two prespecified three-seed paired panels. Traditional installed LRU OPHOURS uses ChangesItemReliability.FRTCF, with its third mission moved from h52 to h23–25 so the h24 reset occurs during operating exposure. Explicit position-A CALHOURS failure mode uses ChangesFailureModeReliability.FRQCF. Each control sets factor 1 at h9 and h24; each intervention sets factor 4 at h9 and 1 at h24.

manual.rule: FRTCF and FRQCF are positive factors applied to initial FRT/FRQ, keyed by IID or FMID and TIMEC. Traditional FRT changes apply only to primary items, while FRQ changes can target a position failure mode. The manual states changes immediately affect mission and preparation exposure.

Otherwise retain v1.0.1 as diagnostic and freeze a new version before further experiments.
